description: Shape the moments that shape a lifetime. The Bachelor of Early Childhood Education (Birth to Five Years) prepares you for a rewarding career teaching and leading learning in early childhood settings, supporting children from birth to five years during a period that matters most for their growth, development and learning. You can apply for this course if you’re a Year 12 school leaver or if you’re an early childhood education and care diploma holder. Eligible diploma holders can apply for credit for first-year units, recognising your existing qualifications and professional experience. Flexible study options Streamlined summer and winter course maps are offered to get you into the workplace quicker, enabling diploma-qualified early childhood education and care applicants to complete the degree qualification in two years. Why ACU? You will develop a strong foundation in early childhood curriculum, pedagogy and professional practice, while gaining the knowledge and skills needed to support children from birth to five years. We also recognise that an early childhood teacher is likely to teach a diverse range of students across the course of their career. Our students will be equipped with knowledge and skills to respond to this diversity. Early childhood teachers are in strong demand across Australia and with a renewed focus on high quality early childhood education and care, this course provides graduates with the knowledge and skills that will lead to a rewarding career with our youngest learners. Professional experience Hands-on experience is a core part of your course. Throughout the course, you’ll complete 80 days of supervised professional placement in relevant early childhood and prior to school settings, carefully matched to your stage of study. Work placement These placements allow you to apply and strengthen your skills in the early childhood setting, gaining valuable experience from professionals and building experience and confidence before you graduate. You’ll also gain experience across a range of early childhood settings, helping you build confidence, broaden your perspective and make informed decisions about your future career. description: The refreshed Bachelor of Exercise and Sports Science delivers a nationally consistent, practice-centred curriculum built around 20 shared core units and two contemporary majors - Sport Performance and Exercise Rehabilitation. First-year foundations have been tightened and sequenced to build capability early (e.g., Physiological Foundations → Applied Exercise Physiology → Adaptation to Exercise), with biomechanics, motor control and learning, psychology and exercise programming integrated into authentic labs and field tasks. A key outcome of the redesigned first year is eligibility for Aus. Active Personal Trainer registration, enabling most single-degree students to register and practice after Year 1 (and typically after Year 2 in double degrees). Mid-course, a strengthened checkpoint unit in Exercise Assessment and Conditioning introduces secure, skills-based assessments to ensure students can design, justify and deliver safe, evidence-based programs before entering practicum. The majors have been modernised with specialist options preparing student for their chosen career progressions. Professional learning is capped by a two-stage practicum: Professional Experience 1 (internal, supported) and Professional Experience 2 (external). Across the pair, students complete placements at a minimum of two sites and 140 hours (including 90 hours of exercise testing, prescription and delivery), and undertake secure capstone assessments (including an Objective Structured Clinical Examination - OSCE) to validate graduate readiness. The program is aligned to ESSA standards to achieve graduate Accredited Exercise Scientist registration and builds ASCA accreditation requirements into the strength & conditioning sequence (e.g., resistance training and athlete preparation units), with the expectation that students in ESSA-accredited courses will be positioned to achieve ASCA Level 1 accreditation as a minimum.

description: ACU’s Bachelor of Visual Arts and Design tailors a blend of studio-based fine art, graphic design, and art history. With dedicated studios and workshops, learn how to harness your individual style and develop your skills as a graphic designer and contemporary artist through real-world studio practice and industry placements in the creative industries. description: The Master of Dietetic Practice is a 2-year full-time program. description: The Master of Professional Psychology (MProf. Psych) is a fifth-year program in psychology, open to graduates of an APAC accredited fourth-year (or equivalent) psychology program. The MProf. Psych program is designed to provide graduates in psychology with an additional year of education in the professional practice of psychology. This year prepares graduates for a final year of supervised practice prior to general registration as a psychologist. The MProf. Psych program provides students with an opportunity to learn and demonstrate their knowledge and skills in the 8 core capabilities and attributes as required to practice psychology. Practicum options include schools, disability services, prisons, not-for-profit and private practice settings.
